What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

COREMERCH's digital commerce stacks are not workarounds, but base-layer infrastructure built with free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Google Apps Script, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This means creators own their entire online store, from product delivery to customer data, without relying on centralized platforms that can restrict or freeze their accounts. With a sovereign commerce stack, creators can focus on producing high-quality digital products, knowing their infrastructure is secure, scalable, and under their full control.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here's how it works: creators deploy their online store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store order information, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handle file delivery. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC or buyer account requirements. This architecture ensures seamless and secure delivery of digital products, regardless of the creator's location or currency.
